events.title: The S&P 500 has only risen this quickly 4 times since WWII. Once, a historic stock-market crash followed.
events.blurb: The S&P 500 has overcome worries about artificial intelligence and the fallout from the war in Iran to stage one of its strongest two-month showings on record.
